title: 3/9 rations support the brigade
placementNote: Pre-July predecessor/background material; chapter coverage must be deliberately decided before publication.

paragraphs.text: The initial brigade supply crisis was met with the 15 days of rations landed with McPartlin’s battalion and an emergency airlift from Saigon. This describes brigade logistics, not 15 days without resupply.

notes: Source references support the whole proposal; normalized OCR is not a human correction.
